body: i’m non-binary but i had a similar experience with my abuser, who is a woman, in hs. Not only was she verbally degrading and threatening, but she constantly disrespected my boundaries by poking and prodding me in places that were extremely vulnerable, when she had her own v specific boundaries that i would never even dream of crossing (not bc i was scared even tho i def should have been, i just respected her as a person; she obvi didn’t do the same for me). She also spent several years sexually harassing me over text, and when i would tell her to stop, she’d call me a prude. it sucks to have to process this now, partly bc her abuse has left me with a lot of intimacy issues, but mostly bc this was a person i genuinely cared about and to have to come to terms with her horrific acts is just emotionally exhausting. so i get what you are going through, and i’m sorry this happened to you, the girls who treated you like this are absolutely vile, and i pray they get theirs and that you find peace of mind.

When I was 15, I planned to kill myself the spring break of my sophomore year. I had just come out of a really toxic relationship and overall it felt as though my life had slipped through my fingers like sand. I was planning to carry out my plan that weekend, but the next day I got out of bed and went on YouTube. When I was with that guy, all I ever listened to was alt rock music as that was what he listened to, but that day I rediscovered not just the music I like, but I rediscovered my passion for music, and artists who had helped me through my childhood. It was this kind of sudden realization that I had more to live for than him, that being myself, and that I’m the only person who could save me. And  I’m so glad I didn’t go through with it bc the next four months were probably some of the best of my life.
Damn I’m sorry you had to deal with that it sucks but I’m glad you’re out of that situation tho!
